title: Directed Observances
subtitle: Service made legible
text: Acolytes, Zealots, and Guardians assign Observances: practical work that teaches the habits of cleansing. Healthy seekers begin with five sequential service vows; purifying candidates receive treatment observances as their Purity advances. Speak to the directing guide to accept available work, perform the named action or gather the offering, and return to an NPC of that office to fulfill it. The Book records what is locked, available, active, ready, or fulfilled.
